title: RHO-Explosive-Design: code, logs and run-level records for a known-optimum benchmark of surrogate-assisted search for RDX/TNT/HTPB formulations
description: Code, execution log, run-level candidate records and figure scripts accompanying the manuscript 'Surrogate-Assisted Search for RDX/TNT/HTPB Formulations Using Thermochemical Simulations: A Known-Optimum Benchmark of Surrogate Topology, Thermochemical-Call Efficiency and Explanation Fidelity' (Processes, processes-4701050). Version 1.1.0 replaces v1.0.0: the Kamlet-Jacobs product allocation now conserves C, H, N and O, and all data, models and results were regenerated. Adds a direct Kamlet-Jacobs search arm, recalculation of the candidate returned by every run, an equal thermochemical-call budget comparison, a comparison of SHAP attributions with the known Kamlet-Jacobs model, and a check of the Differential Evolution polishing setting. All targets are theoretical; no experimental data are used.
